_doc: Save this file as .mcp.json at your project root. Claude Code finds it at the next start and asks you to approve the server. The same result from the command line: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http emem https://emem.dev/mcp. Without --scope project, the command writes to the default local scope (~/.claude.json), not to .mcp.json. The value "type": "http" names the MCP Streamable HTTP transport. It does not mean plain HTTP; the URL is HTTPS. If your runtime cannot use Streamable HTTP, replace the entry with {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://emem.dev/mcp"]}. That bridge needs Node.js. Do not keep both entries, or every tool loads twice.
